profile.headline: Web Development at Shy Wolf Studios
profile.summary:
Los Angeles-based engineer with 8+ years of experience in client facing roles as a project- and technical-lead. 

On the weekend I build responsive websites and full stack web applications for my community at https://shywolf.co/

I have built my career human first; I strive to always protect the wellness, equity, and inclusivity of anyone impacted by my work.

positions.title: Owner / Web Developer
positions.description: Boutique web development studio in Los Angeles, CA. We build beautifully responsive websites and full stack web applications for our community! Get in touch at https://shywolf.co/

positions.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
positions.description:
7+ years of experience as project- and technical-lead on a number of multi-million dollar engineering projects. Known for reliable organization skills, meticulous attention to detail, and empathetic engagement with stakeholders, from clients to engineers.

Involved in full interdisciplinary design process, from concept to construction and value engineering. Expertise in technical report writing, deliverable reviews, and technical system design and documentation.

Adapted novel computational approach to automate space data and geometry laundry scripts for software cross-compatibility between Revit and IES. Saved hundreds of hours in resolving construction challenges through computation-based QAQC programs and integrated mapping of thermal analysis within CAD programs.

Led and developed an overhaul of internal US engineering wiki and knowledge database. Co-led small team engineers to refresh of region-wide mechanical documentations and standards.

Proven dedication to firm culture and ethos, with leadership roles including West Coast Computational Champion and two-year role as co-chair of the US Diversity & Inclusion Forum.

Company Roles: Diversity & Inclusion Forum (US Region Co-Chair), Racial Equity Working Group (Founding Member), Knowledge Management Working Group (Founding Member), Young Engineer's Forum (Social Media Chair, Volunteer Chair), Computational Collective (Member), West Coast Computational Champion, Future of the Office Committee (Founding Member), SPARK K-12 Mentorship (Mentor), Life Safety Response Team (Fire Warden), Lunch & Learn Coordinator  

Experience: Concept Design, Schematic Design, Design Development, Construction Documents, Construction Administration, Value Engineering, Submittals, RFIs, Basis of Design Reports, Design Memos, Client Presentations, Plant Design, Electrification, Space Planning, Thermal Loads Analysis, Equipment Selection, Computational Automation, Project Coordination, LEED Documentation
